title: Design From theme
description: The Design From Labs color, radius and focus tokens for light and dark, using shadcn's variable names.
a11y: Text tokens meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) on their background tokens in light and dark.
The ring token reaches at least 3:1 against the background, so focus indicators stay visible.
docs: Added the Design From theme to your CSS variables (light and dark). Every Labs component reads these tokens through Tailwind utilities such as `bg-primary` and `ring-ring`.
